verdict.rationale: An LLM API gateway could plausibly offer versioned, reviewable, and revertible routing presets or workflow configs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way to version, review, or roll back automations. The 'latest' model alias and model fallbacks concern model selection and runtime routing, not change management of user automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
